items.title: Data centre construction stocks lose $4.2tn as boom in AI trade unravels
items.desc: The FT reports that shares of data-centre construction companies have lost about $4.2 trillion in value as the AI investment trade unwinds. Based on the headline and feed teaser only. [Financial Times, published 2026-11-15]

items.title: Congress moves to pass tighter AI chip export rules following Nvidia scandal
items.desc: The FT says Congress is moving to pass tighter export rules for AI chips in the wake of the Nvidia scandal. Based on the headline and feed teaser only. [Financial Times, published 2026-11-15]

items.title: Samsung conquered AI chips. Now it wants to build data centres
items.desc: The FT looks at Samsung's push to move from supplying AI chips into building data centres. Based on the headline only. [Financial Times, published 2026-11-15]

items.title: The Individual Investors Who Are Hot on Anthropic's IPO But Cool on AI
items.desc: The WSJ reports on individual investors who are eager for an Anthropic IPO yet lukewarm on AI stocks more broadly. Based on the headline only. [WSJ, published 2026-11-15]

items.title: New AI Millionaires Want Wealth Advisers Who Can Help Give Their Money Away
items.desc: The WSJ describes newly wealthy AI-industry employees seeking wealth advisers who can help them with philanthropy. Based on the headline only. [WSJ, published 2026-11-15]

items.title: Facing Backlash on Land, Data Centers Look to the Sea
items.desc: The WSJ reports that, amid local opposition to land-based facilities, data-centre developers are exploring offshore sites. Based on the headline only. [WSJ, published 2026-11-14]

items.title: India Stock Market Rebounds as AI Trade Unwinds, Foreign Funds Return
items.desc: Bloomberg reports that Indian equities are rebounding as the AI trade unwinds and foreign funds return. Based on the headline only. [Bloomberg, published 2026-11-15]

items.title: Tech Giants Face More Grid Cost Pressure on Democratic Sweep
items.desc: Bloomberg says big tech firms face growing pressure to bear electricity-grid costs after a Democratic sweep. Based on the headline only. [Bloomberg, published 2026-11-14]

items.title: Juicy 6% Yields Gain Appeal After Nvidia Drama: Credit Weekly
items.desc: Bloomberg's credit column says 6% yields are drawing buyers after the Nvidia turmoil. Based on the headline only. [Bloomberg, published 2026-11-14]

items.title: Nvidia CEO's affair exposes loophole Chinese firms use to access high-end chips
items.desc: The Washington Post reports that the Nvidia CEO scandal highlights a loophole Chinese firms use to reach high-end AI chips. Based on the headline only. [Washington Post, published 2026-11-15]
